authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-133 preview TypeScript provider-only output law. It applies nothing, edits no register row, seals nothing, marks nothing SATISFIED, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. D-056 Class A is not opened.

governingBoundary.closingSentence: The boundary is closed for the distribution transition. A process or library split cannot transfer authority.
governingBoundary.designDelta: For the D-002 preview TypeScript *provider* role only, this contract narrows file 01's 'Component may return' column. File 01 remains the general closed boundary. This is a recorded preview-role delta, not a silent rewrite of file 01.

file01MayReturnKept: candidate artifacts and mechanical commitments (fact/coverage commitments only)
previewNarrowing.rationale: D-132 / file 12 / D-002 provider-only: the TypeScript component is a semantic provider. Findings are produced by host-owned rules over admitted facts. Candidate findings are not an admitted preview-TS-provider output.
previewNarrowing.admissionOfFindings: Host admits findings only from host-owned rule evaluation over admitted facts. There is no component-emitted finding candidate to admit. admissionOfFindings is not a component-payload verb.

registerRowQuoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-133 |'. Compare row text, not a remembered line number.
registerRowQuoted.acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim: Independently reviewed contract stating: the TypeScript component returns semantic facts and Coverage only; the host owns rules, policy, findings, and admission; component-emitted findings are refused, with retained negative tests.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: the TypeScript component returns semantic facts and Coverage only
obligationDecomposition.readAs: For the preview TypeScript provider, admitted *semantic* outputs are facts and Coverage. Protocol frames required to deliver those (handshake, snapshot accept, complete, cancel, unavailable, budget) are not additional semantic products. File 01 findings/scores/intermediates are removed for this role.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: the host owns rules, policy, findings, and admission
obligationDecomposition.readAs: Rules, policy, findings, and admission remain host-owned, matching file 01. The component does not own them.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: component-emitted findings are refused, with retained negative tests
obligationDecomposition.readAs: Any worker output that is not an admitted semantic output or an admitted protocol frame is refused before admission. Retained classes are constructible on the existing TypeScript provider wire, not a fictional well-formed Finding payload.

outputLaw.findingLikeResult: Any provider value offered as a Finding, or as a fact whose relation/schema is not a host-validated fact relation, or as scores/intermediates in the file 01 Policy/verdict 'may return' sense. No finding schema is invented. The host never reinterprets a provider value as a Finding.

refusal.rule: Two limbs. Type-level: any TypeScript provider output that is not (a) an admitted semantic output type or (b) an admitted existing protocol frame needed to carry those outputs is refused before admission. Content-level: an output of an admitted type is admitted only if it passes host validation — the relation/schema registry for fact candidates, and domain conformance without unknown-to-covered conversion for Coverage. Anything failing that validation is refused before admission. The namedInstances list is examples, not the trigger.
refusal.typedNonSuccessOwner: DR-007 / d9-exit-contract.v1.14. This artifact names the refusal and discard. It mints no D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination. Host maps via existing v1.14 only.

negativeTests.protocolJoin: Classes are constructible against the pinned TypeScript provider wire below. This artifact does not change that wire.

NT-1.name: unknown-Finding-frame
NT-1.input: A worker frame whose type is Finding or any type outside the existing closed worker-to-host vocabulary.
NT-1.pass: Rejected as provider-protocol before any semantic admission. No finding admitted. Uncommitted candidates discarded.

NT-2.name: extra-finding-member-on-closed-payload
NT-2.input: A named closed worker payload (FactBatch, Coverage, Complete, or sibling) with an added findings/finding/verdict/threshold/waiver member.
NT-2.pass: Unknown-field / schema rejection before admission. No finding admitted.

NT-3.name: fact-candidate-masquerade
NT-3.input: A FactCandidateV1 whose relationSchemaId or payload is provider-minted or mismatched so as to carry a findingLikeResult.
NT-3.pass: Host-owned relation registry rejects before fact admission. Value is not reinterpreted as a Finding.

NT-4.name: policy-verdict-threshold-waiver
NT-4.input: Any constructible extra member or frame attempting to set policyOutcome, verdict, threshold, waiver, or gate.
NT-4.pass: Refused before admission. Host policy is not taken from the component.

NT-5.name: coverage-domain-mutation
NT-5.input: A Coverage payload that narrows, widens, or converts unknown to covered relative to the host-requested domain.
NT-5.pass: Host refuses the domain mutation. Sufficiency remains host-owned. No unknown-to-covered conversion.

wirePin.namedMajor: TypeScript provider major 1 as stated in those bytes
wirePin.note: delivery.v4 is a derivation over v2. Classes are constructible against these v2 bytes. DR-011-R04 contest on later checkers does not move this pin.

NT-6.name: d9-exit-hosttermination-refused
NT-6.input: A constructible extra member or out-of-vocabulary frame carrying a D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination.
NT-6.pass: Rejected before admission. No D9 minted from the component. Mapping remains DR-007 / v1.14 host-owned.

NT-7.name: planAdmission-refused
NT-7.input: A constructible extra member or frame attempting planAdmission or RequestId/ExecutionId allocation.
NT-7.pass: Rejected before admission. Admission remains host-owned.

doesNot: Does not open D-056 Class A.
Does not rewrite file 01's general closed boundary.
Does not change the TypeScript provider wire.
